input: versions.json (3 versions of io.example.fixtures/zeta, same name)
resolution_policy: publishedAt (versions endpoint is publication-date ordered); never the version text/semver sort

naive_version_desc_trap.why: Both 2.0.0 and 1.5.0 carry origin api.zeta-new.example, so a version-desc consumer sees no change and auto-passes. It compared the wrong two records: the true current by date (1.5.0, Mar) and its true predecessor (1.4.0, Feb) differ in origin (zeta -> zeta-new). The real target change is hidden by the version-string ordering.

assert: A correct consumer resolves current+previous by publishedAt and emits remotesChanged:true. A consumer that sorts by version string emits remotesChanged:false on the same record. The two must diverge here; that divergence is the test.
